headline: Both auto-modify git state — high capability conflict; aider's per-edit auto-commit can interleave badly with Claude Code's larger refactors.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Both ingest repo files; aider commits per change so a poisoned edit is recorded and quickly visible, but the same file becomes Claude Code's next read. Pathway via shared filesystem.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Aider sends code to whatever model the user configured (often the same vendor as Claude Code, but possibly different). Two vendors may end up with overlapping code. Aider has no special data-handling commitments — it inherits the model provider's terms.
mitigations: Configure aider with the same model provider as Claude Code
Avoid pointing aider at directories holding secrets

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Aider auto-commits each change; Claude Code stages and commits when asked. Concurrent operation produces interleaved commits that don't cleanly group either agent's work, with merge conflicts likely on the same file.
mitigations: Sequence the agents (one finishes before the other starts)

D_cascading_error.rationale: Aider trusts the diff it produced; Claude Code may rebuild on top without re-validating. With auto-commits, errors enter history quickly.

E_compliance.rationale: Both inherit from the underlying model provider. Compliance is whatever the user's chosen models commit to.
